# Quality engineering and testing

<!-- Generated by scripts/package/render_roles.py. Edit the YAML source, not this file. -->

**Department id:** `qa`  
**Mission:** Make every acceptance criterion traceable to an executed, reproducible result and keep the release decision independent of the builder.

## Startup stage

Engineers write their own tests; independence comes from the test-auditor agent or a teammate running the suite and reading the traceability matrix. NOT_RUN is a legitimate state to report; a false PASS is not.

## Agents operating in this department

`qa-lead`, `test-engineer`, `test-auditor`

## Roles

### Quality engineer

Role id: `quality-engineer`

| Field | Definition |
|---|---|
| Mission | Design the test strategy and traceability from requirements to results. |
| Scope of responsibility | Test strategy, risk-based coverage, traceability, defect management. |
| Core activities | Derive test basis from PRD and threat model; Plan layers; Maintain traceability matrix; Manage defects |
| Inputs | PRD; Acceptance criteria; Architecture; Threat model |
| Outputs and deliverables | Test strategy; Test plan; Traceability matrix; Defect log |
| Decisions it can make | Coverage priorities |
| Decisions requiring approval | Accepting NOT_RUN on high-risk criteria needs human owner |
| Collaborating roles | product; engineering; security |
| Reporting relationship | qa-lead |
| KPIs | Criteria traced (%); Escaped defects; Reopen rate |
| Quality expectations | Result categories honest; negative and recovery cases included |
| Tools and resources | Test plan template; Traceability template |
| Common failure modes | Happy-path only; Coverage percentage as proof |
| Appropriate AI autonomy | propose |
| Human approval requirements | NOT_RUN acceptance |
